title: Track custody for pharmaceutical batches
mechanism: Batch ID + evidence digest + custodian + stage create a custody state machine; unauthorized handover reverts.
prompt: Act as a Solidity and Python Web3 developer. Build track custody for pharmaceutical batches for an isolated test chain. Use Solidity 0.8.30 and web3.py 8.0.0 with EthereumTesterProvider backed by Py-EVM; also allow --rpc for an isolated unlocked local JSON-RPC test chain. Requirements: Batch ID + evidence digest + custodian + stage create a custody state machine; unauthorized handover reverts. Read mock-data.json, derive a canonical SHA-256 digest where required, compile using pinned solc-js 0.8.30, deploy actual EVM bytecode, wait for every receipt and assert receipt status. Include positive and negative authorization/state tests, output chain ID/address/transaction hashes/gas and a deployment manifest. Do not simulate contract state in Python or use mainnet keys. Use OpenZeppelin 5.4.0 for ERC standards. Return Contract.sol, run_activity.py, mock-data.json, compile.cjs, requirements.txt and a detailed troubleshooting guide. Explain integer units, failure cases and what the assertions prove. Never claim a browser wallet or public testnet succeeded unless actually exercised.
